part.summary: The office network, the shared computer and the copies.

section.title: Office network
section.p: The router of the club answers at router.lakeside-rowing.example; its manual is at the supplier's site.
A copy of the shared folder runs every night; the test below lists what would be copied without copying it:
section.listing: rsync --dry-run --archive /srv/club/ backup-box:/copies/club/ test -s /srv/club/register.ods && echo "register present" [ "$(ls /srv/club | wc -l)" -gt 0 ] && echo ok

small.p: Run it with --dry-run first; the brackets in a[b[0]]>1 show how a test is written.
